newsitem.title: USA: Centerior units refinance $873 mln of bonds.
newsitem.headline: Centerior units refinance $873 mln of bonds.

text.p: Centerior Energy Corp said Wednesday that its two operating subsidiaries, Cleveland Electric Illuminating Co and Toledo Edison Co, have refinanced $873 million of high-interest Secured Lease Obligation Bonds.
The transaction is expected to increase the companies' net worth by about $12 million annually, Centerior said.
The bonds, which had interest rates of 10.25 percent and 11.125 percent, were issued in conjunction with the sale/leaseback of a portion of the Bruce Mansfield Plant in Pennsylvania.

"Our improved credit outlook from our proposed merger with Ohio Edison Company to form FirstEnergy Corp helped create this attractive refinancing opportunity," Centerior Chairman and Chief Executive Robert Farling said in a statement. "The refinancing advances the companies' debt reduction objectives."
